Questions:
Thank you for your M3 submission. Re your GitHub Link, please clarify the below points before we proceed to later milestones: As mentioned by Curtis (your PR reviewer), could you explain why new schema is required instead of extending on the existing one? Please share the changes and impact of these changes (the before- and after- file size comparison to show the impact?) Could the goal have been achieved by modifying the existing schema instead?
Answers: (thank you for your great questions)
・**Schema Model Update:**We revised our approach by enhancing the existing schema model with exclusions rather than creating a new schema. This allowed us to maintain compatibility with the previous version.
・**External Private Key Option:**One of the key updates was the introduction of an option to use an external private key for encrypting backups. This gives clients greater control, enabling them to use their own privately generated keys for backup and restoration processes.
・**Compression Feature:**We implemented a compression option that significantly reduces the size of backup data. Testing demonstrated this improvement:

・Without compression: 17,897 characters (source)
・With compression: 9,811 characters (source)

This represents nearly a 50% reduction in JWE length for the same backup data. We anticipate even greater scalability, leading to substantial savings in data size.
For context, this PR addresses the GitHub issue: https://github.com/hyperledg
